entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I hope you can help me. I'm a bit lost with all this. I bought something... a shirt... and it's just not right.
I can certainly try to help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's... uh... Maria Garcia. The order number is... VF78-99-012. It's this jersey I ordered, and the sizing is all wrong.

Okay, Maria, I see your order for the Aero-Vent jersey from about a month ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?

It's the wrong size. I just don't get it. Your website had all these charts and I tried to follow them, but this jersey is way too tight. I can barely zip it up. I'm so confused. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria. I apologize for the confusion with the sizing charts. It sounds like you need to do an exchange for a larger size. Let me just quickly confirm the return eligibility for you.
Oh, I hope so. It's been over a month, I think. I get so overwhelmed with these things.

No problem at all. Let me see... okay, I see you received the item 35 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a return or exchange. So we can definitely get this sorted out for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send back the one that's too tight?
Absolutely. I am processing the return for you right now. I can email you a prepaid shipping label. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to set up an exchange for the next size up?
An exchange would be wonderful! I really like the jersey, it's just the wrong size. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You're very welcome, Maria. I've just sent that label to your email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
